summary: Renewable Natural Gas Incentive Act of 2025 This bill establishes a federal tax credit, through 2035, equal to $1 for each gallon of renewable natural gas (compressed or liquified gas derived from biomass) or gasoline gallon equivalent of a nonliquid renewable natural gas used or sold for use as a fuel in a motor vehicle, a motorboat, or in aviation. Under the bill, a gasoline gallon equivalent of a nonliquid renewable natural gas is the amount of the fuel that has a Btu content of 124,800 (higher heating value). Specific registration and other conditions apply.
